scope: Fresh headless offline component and inert simulation harness. Optional or unstarted capabilities remain explicit skips. This is not proof of all-sensor live protection or real-attack coverage.
counting_note: The 84 catalog modules have 66 PASS and 18 SKIP results. The separate synthetic event-pipeline PASS raises the runner total to 85 rows and 67 PASS; it is not an extra catalog module.

verification.interpretation: A PASS for a defect, exception, malformed-result, or timeout canary means the verifier recognized the expected defect; these are controlled fixtures.

readback_scope: The saved all-module report was compared exactly with in-memory results and verification during the named saved-report-readback phase, which passed. A later Reliability phase intentionally replaces the auxiliary selftest_failures.json with a separate focused run; no final equality with that auxiliary file is claimed.

module_metrics.timing_scope: checks and verification; excludes report I/O and notifications

constrained_worker_fixture.scope: Controlled two-worker offline fixture; this is a concurrency/completion check, not a physical older-hardware throughput claim.

phases.phase: Self-test verification — canaries, inventory coverage and saved report readback
Self-test performance — constrained hardware worker budget and completion
Unified Red Team Simulation (dialog + engine params)
Red Team drill — LIVE run (complexity + custom + target)
Reliability fixes (watchdog, self-test log, SOAR guard, fixes log)
Console cmds + custom library CRUD + two-pane monitor
Vetted remediation (inert path proposals + gated host actions)
ATT&CK coverage heatmap (honest, cross-checked vs ACTIONS)
World View → native Qt flow window (live)
Speed pass (WAL + ledger cap + audit-count cache)

sanitization: Diagnostic details, run identifiers, operator/model paths, command output, and raw failure or skip reasons are omitted; only catalog/check names, statuses, timings, counters, and worker observations are retained.
